WANING.gloss: a gradual decrease in magnitude or extent
WANING.definition: A gradual decrease in magnitude or extent.
WANING.example: The waning of his enthusiasm was obvious.

AWNING.definition: A canopy made of canvas to shelter people or things from rain or sun.

WING.definition: A movable organ for flying (one of a pair).

WIN.gloss: be the winner in a contest or competition
WIN.definition: Be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious.

INN.gloss: a hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers
INN.definition: A hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers.

WAN.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble.
WAN.example: The pale light of a half moon.

GIN.gloss: strong liquor flavored with juniper berries
GIN.definition: Strong liquor flavored with juniper berries.

WIG.definition: Hairpiece covering the head and made of real or synthetic hair.
